author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.18.0 — Root-cause fix for status being frozen for hours at a time: vacuum_work_status, the field status was derived from, does not actually exist in this endpoint's response for this vacuum (confirmed live via a raw dump added in 1.17.1). status is now derived from mode instead -- a field that genuinely is present in both polls, using the same code groups as the existing mode attribute's own (previously cross-validated) mapping, with charging breaking the tie between docked-and-idle vs. genuinely-off-dock. This is the real fix behind everything the 1.15.0-1.17.1 patches were working around: notifications not firing, sweeps not continuing, status disagreeing with charging/mode.
